title: Take-home part 3: the README
statement:
Останній крок — README, з якого рев'юер почне. Напиши його для свого take-home з каталогом Gadgetly (частина 2). Рев'юер має за 5 хвилин: встановити й запустити тести, зрозуміти структуру, побачити, що покрито і що ні.

Секції: **How to run** (команди з нуля на Windows або macOS/Linux), **Structure**, **What is covered and why**, **Not covered / next steps**.

fields.label: Not covered / next steps (one per line)

rules.message: How to run: venv → `pip install -r requirements.txt` → `python -m playwright install chromium` → `python -m pytest`.
Скажи, проти якої адреси запускаються тести і як її змінити (`--base-url` / `PYTEST_BASE_URL`).
Поясни, що покрито і чому саме це — кілька речень.
Розкажи і про API-, і про UI-частину.

model.run:
Requirements: Python 3.13, Gadgetly running at http://localhost:5173 (or any other address).

python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate          # macOS/Linux: source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m playwright install chromium
python -m pytest                 # all tests
python -m pytest -m api          # API only, no browser

Another environment: python -m pytest --base-url https://staging.example.test (or set PYTEST_BASE_URL).
Reports: python -m pytest --junitxml=reports/junit.xml --html=reports/report.html --self-contained-html
model.structure:
models/product.py — pydantic model Product (extra=forbid, strict) = the API contract.
api tests use a small client (fixture api + get_products helper) with a timeout on every request.
pages/catalog_page.py — CatalogPage page object: locators by labels and data-testid, helpers card(), add_to_cart(), price_values(). Tests never use page.get_by_… directly.
tests/api — contract, category filter (parametrized), pagination, limits.
tests/ui — sorting, in-stock filter with the counter, out-of-stock button.
conftest.py — fixtures api and catalog; pyproject.toml — testpaths, markers api/ui, --strict-markers, base_url.
model.covered: API first: the contract of every product, the category filter with exact counts, pagination without overlaps and the limit boundary — the catalog page depends on this data, and API tests are fast and stable. UI covers what only a browser shows: the order of cards after sorting by price (all prices checked, not just the first), the result counter against the number of cards with In stock only, and that an out-of-stock product cannot be added to the cart. All tests are independent and read-only (the catalog is not changed), so they can run in parallel with -n auto.
next: Search: case-insensitive partial match and the empty result message
Price range boundaries (inclusive min/max) as a parametrized UI test and the same via API (minPrice/maxPrice)
Run in Firefox and WebKit (browser matrix in CI)
GitHub Actions workflow with JUnit XML and traces as artifacts

checklist: Команди з нуля: venv, pip install -r requirements.txt, playwright install, pytest
Структура: модель, page object, фікстури, конфігурація
Що покрито і чому (ризики, API першим)
Чесні наступні кроки — без «не встиг(ла)» без пояснень
Жодних паролів і токенів у README
